candidates.violated_requirement: Gray-to-binary conversion should use previous binary bits, not Gray code bits. This mutation causes incorrect binary conversion by XORing two Gray code bits instead of Gray with previous binary bit.
candidates.spec_basis: The Gray code to binary conversion should follow the pattern: bin_out[3] = gray_wire[3]; bin_out[2] = gray_wire[2]^bin_out[3]; bin_out[1] = gray_wire[1]^bin_out[2]; bin_out[0] = gray_wire[0]^bin_out[1];
